items.title: Chawinga sisters fire Malawi into Wafcon final
items.summary: Malawi's fairy tale run at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations goes on as sisters Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga share three goals in a 3-1 semi-final win over Algeria.

items.title: GB's Hudson-Smith wins historic 400m gold on home track
items.summary: Great Britain's Matthew Hudson-Smith makes history as the joint-most decorated man of all-time at European Championships by claiming 400m gold in Birmingham.
